verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a managed streaming service with a control-plane API and CLI, so the axis applies. The pack never documents batch or bulk operations across multiple channels, stages, or streams. It mentions only a CLI region flag and single EventBridge rules, which are adjacent features and do not show multi-item bulk actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
